documentedIn: docs/reference/openwa-api.md 6.6 Webhook Events (event catalog, idempotency keys)
description: message.ack (read): a receipt advances an outbound message. Payload {id, messageId, status, ack}; there is NO chat id.

headers.X-OpenWA-Signature: sha256=<HMAC-SHA256 hex of the raw body with the webhook secret>

notes: `status` is canonical (pending|sent|delivered|read|failed); `ack` is the deprecated legacy integer (1 sent, 2 delivered, 3 read).
UNVERIFIED: whether `id` and `messageId` are the same value (the reference only lists both). Look the row up by `messageId`, falling back to `id`.
